capabilities: edit slides with a thumbnail sidebar, drag-to-reorder, and a slide clipboard
type and format text directly on the slide canvas with a floating toolbar
paste, drag, and resize images with snap guides and percentage-based positions
play decks in any browser with keyboard navigation, fullscreen, and PDF export
scaffold decks from built-in templates and optionally regenerate slides via a local Claude Code CLI
extras: Desktop only (uses iframes, the local filesystem, and optionally a local CLI); requires Obsidian 1.5.0+; registers itself as the viewer for .html files and may conflict with other plugins that handle .html; AI mode may send slide content to Anthropic's API under the user's own account; UI ships in English and Traditional Chinese.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to author self-contained HTML slide decks with visual, PPTX-style editing inside the vault.

relations.evidence: sends the selected slide + the deck's CSS + your instruction to a local Claude Code CLI (claude -p)

summary: Slide deck editor that builds single-file HTML presentations with drag-to-reorder slides, inline text editing, image placement, and a built-in player.
